conversation_starters.title: Here's what the City of San Antonio plans to do with the Spurs' $2.5 million repayment for failed MLS bid
conversation_starters.summary: Continuation of Spurs $2.5M payment story with a local angle on city spending. You could open with: Did you see what the city plans to do with that $2.5M the Spurs paid back?
